name: cretan-cat
description: A pixel-art Cretan cat above the prompt, Manousos unless you name it. Clawd tells the cat what to do while Claude works, and it answers in song: Cretan mantinades, coplas and tangos, English couplets, or posh British ones.

name.title: Cretan cat: his name
name.description: What the cat is called, in the caption and when Clawd talks to him, up to 20 characters; Luna, say. /cat name <name>.

coat.title: Cretan cat: coat
coat.description: His fur: manousos is dark brown with a white bib and mittens, ginger an orange tabby, tuxedo black and white, tabby grey with a cream belly. /cat coat manousos|ginger|tuxedo|tabby.

language.title: Cretan cat: what Clawd speaks
language.description: The language Clawd nags him in, and his short answers: greek, english, spanish as they speak it in Buenos Aires (¡Dale, arrancamos!), or british, posh and older (Splendid, shall we begin?). /cat language greek|english|spanish|british.

songs.title: Cretan cat: what he sings
songs.description: The songs in his bubble while Claude works: Cretan mantinades (greek), English couplets, coplas and tangos (spanish), or posh British couplets with a prog-rock streak (british). /cat songs greek|english|spanish|british.

temper.title: Cretan cat: temper
temper.description: On: he slaps Clawd for nagging, sometimes swats your hand and naps on your keyboard. /cat temper on|off.

sound.title: Cretan cat: sound
sound.description: A trill, a mew, a purr and a hiss, on macOS. /cat sound on|off.

resolution.title: Cretan cat: resolution
resolution.description: high draws the yard as a sharp picture in kitty and Ghostty terminals (cmux recommended); low works everywhere. /cat resolution high|low.

place.title: Cretan cat: where he lives
place.description: band gives him the whole yard above the prompt with Clawd; small, just him in a little square at the right; dock, a pane of his own on the side. /cat band|small|dock.

hints.title: Cretan cat: hints
hints.description: On: the napping caption ends with tips such as "/cat help · /cat hide"; off, it just says he is napping. /cat hints on|off.

ai.title: Cretan cat: AI songs
ai.description: On: one small Haiku call a turn writes his song and Clawd's nudges about your task, sending a few topic words from the prompt you typed (secret-looking words taken out: a filter, not a guarantee) and session counts; at most 100 calls a day, then the built-ins. /cat ai on|off.
